spec.name: Furniture Witch Broom Bundle
spec.description: A crooked dark-oak broom with golden straw and purple binding, accompanied by a small bent witch hat and ribbed orange pumpkin. Grounded, connected furniture with a hand-painted vanilla palette, facing negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: upright witch broom with stepped crooked dark wooden handle, golden straw bristles bound with purple ribbon, a small black witch hat and orange pumpkin resting at its base. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
